*PALANTIR NAMES NEBIUS "PREFERRED AI INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNER", ANNOUNCES PARTNERSHIP TO INTEGRATE NEBIUS CLOUD INTO PALANTIR ENTERPRISE PLATFORM $PLTR $NBIS 

Palantir and Nebius announced a partnership today to integrate Nebius's cloud and AI compute infrastructure into Palantir's enterprise platform for commercial customers, according to a joint statement made by both companies.

As part of the agreement, Palantir has named Nebius its "preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner". Nebius compute and inference endpoints will be integrated with the Palantir enterprise system, giving Palantir customers access to Nebius's cloud and inference infrastructure, while retaining control over their compute, data & models.

Alex Karp, founder and CEO of Palantir: "Nebius' compute infrastructure powers your ability to run your own AI models under conditions you control. Our ontology and their infrastructure will undergird the sovereignty our partners are demanding."

Arkady Volozh, founder and CEO of Nebius: "Organizations need both the performance of large-scale AI infrastructure and control over their data and models. Together with Palantir, we are bringing this to commercial clients enabling them to run their optimized open models on trusted infrastructure."

*YIELD GAP BETWEEN U.S. 10-YEAR TREASURY AND CHINESE 10-YEAR TREASURY HITS 3.16%, HIGHEST EVER

For the duration of this bull market over the past 5 years, the 10-Year Treasury Yield has been contained below 4.92%

The last time we saw the 10-Year yield this high was in October 2023. By the end of 2023, the 10-Year yield fell more than a full percentage point over a 2-month period, from 4.92% down to 3.86%

This morning, we tapped that 4.92% spot precisely. If yields are going to reverse, this would be the spot to do so, otherwise we risk a blowout, which would force an accelerated correction/repricing in equity valuations.

If the White House has any magic tricks up their sleeve, now is the time to show their hand.
